name: Pacific & Indian cyclones
summary: Cyclone Murasu has dissipated inland; no GDACS orange or red cyclone alerts in force
state: GDACS listed no orange or red tropical cyclone alerts on 4 Nov; its only active cyclone entry, In-Fa near Japan and the Marshall Islands, is green. Severe cyclonic storm Murasu crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast on 3 Nov and weakened inland, with two deaths reported in Bapatla district (The News Minute, 4 Nov).
for_you: No cyclone currently threatens a populated coast in the Pacific or Indian Ocean. Check national weather agencies such as IMD or JMA before travel in season.
assessor_note: Murasu has dissipated after landfall and GDACS shows no orange or red cyclone alert, so the measured status falls straight to Normal.
why: Typhoons and cyclones are the deadliest weather events, threatening densely populated coasts in Asia and the Indian Ocean.
drivers: Ocean heat, ENSO phase, season (W Pacific peaks Jul–Oct; N Indian Apr–Jun & Oct–Dec).

rubric.alert: GDACS red cyclone alert, or a super-typhoon/severe cyclone landfall on a populated coast.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange cyclone alert, or a typhoon/cyclone threatening land within 72h.
rubric.normal: No GDACS orange/red tropical cyclone alerts.
